title: When Christ to Judgment Shall Descend
description: When Christ to Judgment Shall Descend in Tonic Solfa to ST. FLAVIAN, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for The Psalms of David Imitated in the Language of the New Testament (1719): Psalm 50, part 3, headed “The judgement of hypocrites”.
Watts' psalms were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Common Metre (8.6.8.6). This page sets the words to ST. FLAVIAN; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: When Christ to judg-ment shall de-scend And saints sur-round their Lord, He calls the na-tions to at-tend, And hear his aw-ful word.

lines: When Christ to judgment shall descend
He calls the nations to attend,
"Not for the want of bullocks slain
"Altars and rites and forms are vain,
"They call my statutes just and true,
"But I shall bring your crimes to light,
Consider, ye that slight the Lord,
If once you fall beneath his sword,

source: Isaac Watts, The Psalms of David Imitated (1719)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to ST. FLAVIAN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
